t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on mockup of a warm limestone paper engineering drawing sheet inside a fine navy border. Left half: a large light-weight sans headline in navy, sentence case, with generous empty space. Right half: a navy hairline construction drawing of concentric circles, crosshairs and dotted arcs, crossed by one steel-blue line, with a narrow column of tiny mono numbered note lines beside it for <CONTENT>. Bottom-right: a small four-row title block with mono labels. Flat line art, no shading, square corners, calm and spare.
signature_idea: The section is a blank drawing sheet whose title block asks what a case study must carry: figure, method, report, approval.
strengths: drawing-sheet border and title block are a strong, ownable frame
very calm, lots of space, light navy headline on limestone
single steel-blue accent used exactly once
title block rows give a clear hook for real content
weaknesses: the diagram is abstract geometry with no meaning for water systems
numbered notes column is empty filler lines, not content
content is almost absent; reads as a cover page rather than a section
title block fields are blank so the concept carries no information
brand_fit_why: Navy on limestone, light headline, mono labels, one accent and square corners fit perfectly, but the drawing is meaningless decoration and the sheet holds almost no content.
